t: Powerful, buffered cleaning agent in a ready-to-use spray. Retains the same powerful effect during soaking and brushing. Restores colour and removes stubborn dirt, stains, marks, and discolouration from grout. Spray onto surface, leave to work, then scrub and wipe clean. Can be used on brick as well as ceramic, porcelain, or slate tiles. Ideal for use in kitchens, bathrooms, showers, ensuites, swimming pools, and utility areas.
